info.title: Rymote.Cli
info.description: Laravel-style CLI + MCP server for the Rymote backend starter.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: rymote — CLI + MCP server for the Rymote backend starter.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a new Rymote backend project from the embedded template.

options.name: --no-git
options.description: Skip `git init` after scaffolding.

options.name: --skip-restore
options.description: Skip `dotnet restore` after scaffolding.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Drop .rymote.json into an existing Rymote starter (adopt).

options.name: --default-module
options.description: Default module hint to seed in .rymote.json.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check that the local environment is ready: .NET SDK, Postgres, JWT key.

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the Rymote host (dotnet run, or docker compose up with --cluster).

options.name: --cluster
options.description: Use docker-compose.cluster.yml overlay (two-node cluster demo).

commands.name: make
commands.description: Scaffolding commands (module, handler, model, migration, event, endpoint, middleware).

commands.name: module
commands.description: Scaffold a new module pair (Rymote.Modules.<Name> + .Contracts).

options.name: --schema
options.description: Postgres schema name; defaults to lowercased module name.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

commands.name: handler
commands.description: Scaffold a Pulse handler (rpc, rpcstream, event, or datagram).

options.name: --kind
options.description: Handler kind: rpc, rpcstream, event, or datagram.

options.name: --handle
options.description: Pulse handle string (e.g. "chat.rooms.create"). Defaults to <module>.<name>.

options.name: --route-param
options.description: Route parameter name (e.g. "roomId"). Only meaningful for handles like chat.rooms.{roomId}.post.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module to add the handler to.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Scaffold a Radiant SmartModel class in a module.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module to add the model to.

commands.name: migration
commands.description: Scaffold a FluentMigrator migration file for a module.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module to add the migration to.

commands.name: event
commands.description: Scaffold a Synapse event record in a module's Contracts project.

options.name: --subscribe-in
options.description: Module that should subscribe to this event.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

commands.name: endpoint
commands.description: Scaffold a minimal-API endpoint class for a module.

options.name: --handler-name
options.description: Handler class name (defaults to inferred from path).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module to add the endpoint to.

arguments.name: METHOD
arguments.description: HTTP method: Get, Post, Put, Delete, Patch.

commands.name: middleware
commands.description: Scaffold a Pulse middleware class for a module.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Compute the change set without writing files.

arguments.name: MODULE
arguments.description: Module to add the middleware to.

commands.name: db
commands.description: Database operations (migrate, rollback, status, reset).

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Run pending migrations against the configured Postgres.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Roll back to a target migration version.

arguments.name: VERSION
arguments.description: Target migration version (e.g. 202605190001). Use 0 to roll back all.

commands.name: status
commands.description: List applied vs pending migrations (v1.1).

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Rollback all + remigrate (v1.1).

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Inventory commands (modules, handlers, events, routes).

commands.name: modules
commands.description: List discovered IModule implementations.

commands.name: handlers
commands.description: List discovered Pulse handler registrations.

options.name: --module
options.description: Filter to a single module.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Filter to a single kind: rpc, rpcstream, event.

commands.name: events
commands.description: List discovered Synapse event declarations and their subscribers.

commands.name: routes
commands.description: List all HTTP endpoints and Pulse handles across modules.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Boot an MCP server over stdio for AI agents.
